name: Visitor Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Passport must remain valid for at least 3 months beyond the stay if a visa is required.
Must present a confirmed return or onward ticket.
Visitor entry permits stays for relaxation, sports, health, family, study, religious, or business purposes for up to 3 months (duration varies by nationality), provided no paid work occurs.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid 3+ months beyond stay (where a visa is required)
Proof of accommodation and sufficient funds

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days for visa-exempt nationalities (duration varies by nationality)

sources.title: Princess Juliana International Airport (SXM) -- Immigration & Visas: passport validity, visa-exempt 90-day stay, return-ticket requirement, entry form

Ministry of Justice, Government of Sint Maarten -- Immigration and Border Protection Services: tourist stay up to 3 months (duration varies by country of origin) for specified purposes, no paid work permitted

notes: NEW COUNTRY, first route of Sint Maarten's initial build. Sint Maarten is the Dutch-administered half of the island of Saint Martin, and (like Aruba and Curacao, built earlier this session) an autonomous constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands -- NOT a British Overseas Territory. Citizenship here is Dutch nationality via the Kingdom-level IND, not a local citizenship regime; see sx_naturalisation.json.
